WITH sales AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999)
SELECT sales.gross_sales, refunds.refunds, sales.gross_sales - refunds.refunds AS net_sales FROM sales, refunds

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS gs, sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) gs_ns
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id <> 999),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sum(r.refund_net) AS rf
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id <> 999),
ns AS (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) rf_ns FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id<>999 AND f.staff_purchase_flag)
SELECT gs - rf AS fiscal_p05_net, gs_ns, rf_ns FROM sales, refunds, ns
